import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
input_dir = "./input"
output_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv")

# Features
ids = test_df["id"]
X_train = train_df.drop(columns=["id", "target", "f_27"])
y_train = train_df["target"]
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=["id", "f_27"])

# Split Train (Hold-out validation)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Model
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    max_depth=8,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    class_weight="balanced",
)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict Test
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Submit
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": ids, "target": y_test_pred})
submission.to_csv(f"{output_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)
